experimental_outcomes.full-sensor-update: Combined update proof remains experimental; two independently checked full-64 finite-table obligations (existing-ID update and fresh-ID first-argmin eviction) pass as a pair. This does not claim every branch is jointly proven.
experimental_outcomes.late-append-combined: Combined append case was not run under the current assertion-only/all-loops configuration. An earlier run with a different model configuration exceeded driver resources; no result for the current configuration and no proof conclusion.
experimental_outcomes.late-overflow-combined: Combined overflow case with the registered all-loops preset reached CBMC SAT/UNSAT results, then Kani's driver failed allocating about 13.3 GB; no result JSON was produced. No proof conclusion.
experimental_outcomes.tracker-late-replay-rollback: The combined late-replay proof exceeded driver memory/time limits. Its fixed two-event fixture property is supported only if all six output-capacity-1 projections, all six capacity-2 projections, and both actual-caller reachability proofs pass. Arbitrary-prestate rollback is not established by that fixture proof.

proof_scope_notes.exact_head_ci: Separate required CI evidence on the proposed revision; this local aggregation excludes CI outcomes.
proof_scope_notes.full_sensor_table: The two passing full-capacity proofs cover the selected existing-ID and fresh-ID first-argmin finite-table cases as a pair; the prior combined/full update attempt remains experimental.
proof_scope_notes.late_replay: The 14 passing proofs form six separately proven restoration projections for each output capacity (overflow capacity 1 and append capacity 2), plus one reachability witness per capacity. Their conjunction supports only the fixed two-event, modeled-refusal actual-caller fixture. The arbitrary-prestate rollback claim remains open and is outside that fixture proof's domain.
